patterns.hypothesis: NMS-free should show tighter tail than NMS path (deterministic latency).
patterns.test: Compare nms=True vs nms=False p95/max on same images; tail-ratio delta >15% = meaningful.

patterns.hypothesis: Over-confident heads inflate count on cluttered frames; check conf histogram.
patterns.test: Plot conf histogram + reliability curve on val2017; ECE >0.05 = miscalibrated.

patterns.hypothesis: ONNX should cut/smooth CPU/GPU latency at same precision; INT8 may cost mAP.
patterns.test: Same 18 images both runtimes; |delta|>15% or max-tail ratio flip = meaningful.

patterns.hypothesis: STAL (YOLO26) should lift AP-small disproportionately; YOLO27 N/S dropping P3 (medium map) predicts AP-medium dip unless compensated — the highest-value falsifiable check once YOLO27 ships.
patterns.test: pycocotools per-area APs/APs/APm/APl on val2017 for 26n/s vs 27n/s; bootstrap 1000x; report ΔAPm with 95% CI; if ΔAPm<0 and CI excludes 0 → dual-scale trade-off confirmed.
patterns.why_hidden: Vendor tables report single mAP; stratification reveals WHERE gains come from — exactly what a PhD contribution needs.

patterns.hypothesis: COCO mAP overstates production readiness on retail/warehouse/aerial (UL37 intent).
patterns.test: Evaluate same checkpoint on COCO val2017 + 2+ domain sets (e.g., SKU-110k retail, VisDrone aerial, warehouse subset); report per-domain ΔmAP; domain-tuned Enterprise backbones should close gap after fine-tune.

rule: No pattern is CONFIRMED without a local artifact + CI. Predictions above are pre-registered to prevent HARKing.
